comment: sptd mode only. The redis server's ConfigMap and TLS Secret are baked into its sealed launcher as descriptor files (opened as /proc/self/fd/N) (rust-envcas nonrelease-dev-baked-volumes); its redis.conf is rewritten to those descriptors. sptd mode uses flask-redis/k8s/manifest.sptd.template.yaml, whose redis.conf turns persistence off (save "", appendonly no), so redis writes nothing to /data and stays a single-container Deployment with no Pod plan. Values are fixed at build time; no rotation. The demo's redis.conf and the sgx/cvm modes are unchanged. flask-redis/scone.sptd.template.yaml registers only redis for now. flask-api is a measured CPython script target (python-script.json: /usr/local/bin/python3.11 -I -B, with the absolute script /app/app.py as its command; the image's relative `python app.py` is refused). Its flask-tls Secret volume at /tls stays a plain Secret volume for now: app.py opens /tls/... by path, so flask-api also needs that volume baked and an sptd source image that links /tls/<key> to /proc/self/fd/N before it can onboard.
